about: Repo › Planning's "Where the work went" on localhost without LOCAL_AI_PREVIEW (scripts/seed/themes-dev.mjs): merged PRs over the last twelve weeks with their cards, four active themes with each PR's theme (one set by a person), a caption, and one proposed theme waiting on an admin (Accept / Rename / Remove). Times are RELATIVE (days_ago), stamped at seed time. PR numbers, titles and links are this repository's real ones.

themes.name: Repo dashboard
themes.description: Capturing the repository's activity for the Repo screen: PRs, CI, deploys, health, usage and hosting providers.

themes.name: Tickets and sprints
themes.description: Tickets, the board, sprints and GitHub issues mirrored as tickets.

themes.name: Billing and plans
themes.description: Plans and their limits, Stripe checkout, buying and gifting a plan.

themes.name: Organizations and sign-in
themes.description: Multi-tenant organizations, the GitHub App install, and signing in with GitHub or Google.

themes.name: Emails and digests
themes.description: The daily and weekly digests, invites, and how Trov's emails look.

caption: Most of the work early on went to the Repo dashboard and to Tickets and sprints; lately it moved to Organizations and sign-in and to Billing and plans.

prs.title: Repo capture, phase 2: environments, deploys, CI failures and check state
prs.what: Environments, deploys, CI failures and check state are captured from webhooks and shown on the Repo screen.

prs.title: Repo capture, phase 3: drift, branches, health pings, and a 10-minute cron
prs.what: Adds branch drift, health pings and a ten-minute cron that polls them.

prs.title: Tickets, sub-tickets, and sprints
prs.what: Tickets become their own records with sub-tickets, and sprints replace milestones.

prs.title: Repo capture, phase 4: coverage, bundle size and TODO counts from CI commit statuses
prs.what: Coverage, bundle size and TODO counts are read from CI commit statuses.

prs.title: Tickets: sprint picker, full-width screens, status-as-property, Triage label
prs.what: A sprint picker on tickets, full-width screens and status shown as a property.

prs.title: Repo capture, phase 5: usage from Cloudflare, Railway and the app's own metrics endpoint
prs.what: Usage comes from Cloudflare, Railway and the app's own metrics endpoint.

prs.title: Agent ticket and sprint writes over MCP
prs.what: Agents can create, edit and move tickets and sprints over MCP, within their lane.

prs.title: Repo dashboard: MCP read tool + skills, Usage redesign, and Poll now for every source
prs.what: An MCP read tool for the dashboard, a redesigned Usage tab and Poll now for every source.

prs.title: Delete sprints, and open sprint writes to every member
prs.what: A sprint can be deleted, and every member may write sprints.

prs.title: Tickets: mirror every GitHub issue as a ticket (locked source link)
prs.what: Every GitHub issue is mirrored as a ticket with a locked link to its source.

prs.title: Tickets board: default view, Testing status, saved drag order, free moves
prs.what: The board becomes the default view with a Testing status and a saved drag order.

prs.title: Email notifications (daily/weekly digests via Resend)
prs.what: Daily and weekly digests are sent through Resend.

prs.title: Admin email preview and send-test-to-me
prs.what: Admins preview the digest and send a test to themselves.

prs.title: Brand band on every email, reworked invite
prs.what: Every email carries the brand band; the invite is reworked.

prs.title: Tickets: free moves out of Done, and delete native tickets
prs.what: A ticket can move out of Done freely, and a native ticket can be deleted.

prs.title: Organizations: multi-tenant Trov, superadmin Platform area, org settings and keys
prs.what: Trov becomes multi-tenant, with a superadmin Platform area and per-org settings and keys.

prs.title: GitHub App: connect repositories by installing Trov
prs.what: An org connects its repositories by installing the Trov GitHub App.

prs.title: Plans and grants: Personal, Team and Enterprise tiers
prs.what: Plan tiers with their limits, and grants that give someone an organization of their own.

prs.title: Billing: buy a Personal or Team plan with Stripe
prs.what: Buying a plan through Stripe Checkout and setting the organization up yourself.

prs.title: Emails in the brand's purple
prs.what: Every email moves to the brand's purple.

prs.title: Free plan, Pro per seat, and a downgrade to Free
prs.what: A Free plan, Pro priced per seat, and a downgrade path to Free.

prs.title: An org's address is /<slug>/ instead of /o/<slug>/
prs.what: Organization addresses drop the /o/ prefix.

prs.title: Open Google sign-up
prs.what: Anyone can sign up with Google.

prs.title: Gift a plan: free until a date, then the organization moves to Free
prs.what: A plan can be gifted until a date, after which the organization moves to Free.

prs.title: Emails: the banner takes the shape of the first-run card
prs.what: The email banner matches the first-run card.

prs.title: Emails: fit a phone (the card is fluid, not 680px)
prs.what: Emails fit a phone: the card is fluid up to 680px.

prs.title: Embedded checkout: pay for Pro inside Trov (off by default)
prs.what: Pro can be bought on a Trov page with Stripe's embedded form; it ships switched off.

prs.title: Fix: a new account that signed up to buy Pro goes on to checkout
prs.what: A new account that chose Pro now reaches checkout after signing up.

prs.title: One GitHub account, several orgs; connect with what you can read
prs.what: Several orgs may share one GitHub App installation and connect the repositories they can read.

prs.title: Hosting providers: Vercel, Render, Netlify, Fly.io
prs.what: One provider interface for hosting, with Org settings › Hosting and Repo › Hosting.
